_help: Your corrections to how the deck builder understands cards. They always win over the builder's own reading and over Scryfall Tagger. Copy an example below, rename the key to a real card name, and keep only the fields you need. Fields: roles_add / roles_remove (ramp, draw, removal, sweeper, counter, tutor, recursion, protection), produces / wants (bodies: body, creature_enters, token_enters, creature_dies, gain_life, draw, to_graveyard, counters_put, land_enters, attacks, untap, artifact_fodder...), concepts_add (board_protect, damage_amp, extra_combat, haste, anthem, etb_payoff, sac_outlet, one_sided_wipe...), staple (true/false), never (true), note. Run the 'Explain cards' workflow to check the result.
